documentation.file_docstring: Dashboard data models for the AgentMesh dashboard API.
member_docstrings: TrafficEntry: Represents a single agent-to-agent communication.
LeaderboardEntry: Agent ranking entry on the trust leaderboard.
TrustTrend: Trust score data point for a time series trend.
AuditLogEntry: A single entry in the dashboard audit log view.
ComplianceReportData: Compliance report summary for dashboard display.
DashboardOverview: Summary overview for the main dashboard view.
